capacityRules: transport.capacity must be >= party.adults + party.children + party.elderly
team users should prefer 29-seat coach or 16-seat van
namHoiAnTransferRules: If destination airport is DAD, include road transfer to Nam Hoi An
If oldTownTraffic=high, move Hội An Old Town earlier or keep resort dinner
If user has elderlyMode=true, prefer buggy and avoid long old town walk
If late arrival after 16:00, avoid VinWonders full park on day 1
parkRules: River Safari should be scheduled morning if weather is sunny/cloudy
If riverSafariStatus=delayed, swap with Bird Show/Folk Culture/Indoor Games
If rainProb >= 60, avoid Water World and outdoor shows
If heatIndex=high, avoid Adventure Land and outdoor walk between 12:00 and 15:30
pacingRules: family with elderly: avoid more than 2 medium/high walkLevel activities in same day
childTired=true: insert rest block within next 60 minutes
elderlyMode=true: prefer buggy, indoor games, craft village, resort pool
queueRules: queueMin >= 40: suggest fastpass or alternate attraction
queueMin >= 55: avoid unless user interest is thrill/adventure and pace=active
River Safari queue >= 45: schedule Bird Show/Folk Culture first
voucherRules: expires within 24h: surface voucher in plan if applicable and user tier is eligible
F&B voucher: match restaurant.acceptsVoucher and minSpend
late checkout: recommend for afternoon/evening flights
old town dining voucher: only recommend if traffic forecast not high
